intro: New Zealand's economy is built on farming, tourism and services.

chapters.title: Farming
text: Milk powder, butter, meat, wool and kiwifruit are big exports. Fonterra is one of the world's biggest dairy exporters. New Zealand also makes wine, especially Sauvignon Blanc.

chapters.title: Tourism and film
text: The Lord of the Rings films boosted tourism, and Wellington has a world-class film effects industry.

cardGroups.intro: Some of the things New Zealand makes and sells to the world.
